voice.text: Good evening. Tonight we review three surprising results from the local cluster: a ternary language model, a low-bit image generator, and a tiny speech synthesizer that runs on a laptop graphics card. All of it, entirely offline.
The old netrunner leaned back, watching the rain trace silver lines down the window. Somewhere past the firewall, a new mind was waking up, and for the first time in years, she smiled.
